nodes.summary: For every number field $K$, the empty set of height-one primes of the ring of integers of $K$ has polar density $0$.
nodes.title: The empty set has polar density zero

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field, let $S$ be a set of height-one primes of the ring of integers of $K$, and let $\zeta_S$ be the partial Dedekind zeta function of $S$. A rational number $\rho$ is a polar density of $S$ when there exist a positive integer $n$, an integer $m$ and a function $F : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ such that $F$ is meromorphic at $1$, $F(s) = \zeta_S(s)^n$ for all $s$ with $\operatorname{Re} s > 1$…
nodes.title: Polar density

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field and $S$ a set of nonzero prime ideals of its ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$. For such a prime $\mathfrak{p}$ let $N(\mathfrak{p}) = |\mathcal{O}_K / \mathfrak{p}|$ be its absolute norm. The partial Dedekind zeta function of $S$ is the function $\zeta_{K,S} : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ given by the Euler product
nodes.title: Partial Dedekind zeta function

nodes.summary: For `σ > 1`, the Dedekind zeta terms `(N v) ^ (-σ)` are summable over the height-one primes of the ring of integers.
nodes.title: Summability of Dedekind zeta terms for σ > 1

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field and let $S$ be a set of height-one primes of the ring of integers of $K$. If $\rho_1$ and $\rho_2$ are both polar densities of $S$, then $\rho_1 = \rho_2$.
nodes.title: Uniqueness of the polar density
